fields.quoted_span: For tenancies in units fully or partially covered by Berkeley's Rent Ordinance, landlords must pay tenants interest on their security deposit at the end of each year and a prorated amount if the tenant moves out before the end of the year.

fields.note: Annual year-end payment and prorating on move-out are stated; the document gives no rate, and the key_value correctly says so.
Rule's effective_date is empty and the document states no effective date for the interest requirement. The July 2024 and 2025 dates relate to other requirements.

fields.quoted_span: For tenancies in units fully or partially covered by Berkeley's Rent Ordinance
fields.note: D007 supports only the fully/partially covered scope. The detailed exemptions (Golden Duplex, owner-shared kitchen/bath, ADU, university, nonprofit co-ops) and the condominium, single-family and subsidized details are not in D007; they rest on D009.
D007 contains no section or chapter citation such as Berkeley Mun. Code ch. 13.76; it refers only to 'Berkeley's Rent Ordinance'.
